RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, April 6, 2018/Chaitra 16, 1940 (Saka)

(Ministries: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Railways)
Total number of questions — 15
Leak of Aadhaar details on a social
media app
*421. SHRI RAVI PRAKASH
VERMA: Will the Minister of
ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to refer to
answers to Starred Question 5, Starred
Question 155 and Unstarred Question
1690 given in the Rajya Sabha on
2 February, 2018, 9 March, 2018 and
9 March, 2018 respectively and state:
(a) the basis on which Government is
claiming that reports regarding leakage of
Aadhaar details of millions of people on
WhatsApp for ` 500/- only is completely
false, without any investigation so far;
(b) whether Government is aware that
there is foolproof evidence of such Aadhaar
details leak and it has not been investigated
till date;
(c) if so, whether Government would
withdraw the FIR against journalists and
newspapers in view of freedom of press
and claim by Government without any
proof;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Strengthening cold chain infrastructure
in Karnataka
*422. DR. PRABHAKAR KORE: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether sufficient cold chain storages
are in place to check wastage of fruits and
vegetables in the country;
(b) the number of cold chain facilities in
Karnataka, district-wise; and
(c) the steps taken by Government, in
consultation with Government of
Karnataka, to further strengthen cold chain
management in the State along with  the
details thereof?
Scam in NCCT
*423. SHRI CHUNIBHAI
KANJIBHAI GOHEL: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to refer to answer to

150
Unstarred Question 40 given in the Rajya
Sabha on 2 February, 2018 and state:
(a) whether any case pertains to illegal
diversion of funds by a National level
cooperative fertiliser unit to another
company, including conflict of interest of a
senior level officer, details thereof;
(b) action taken to stop conflict of
interest activities in National level
cooperative fertiliser units, including side-
stepping of officials, pending inquiry,
allegedly involved in such activities;
(c) whether Ministry proposes to issue
suitable advisory in this regard, if not, the
reasons therefor; and
(d)  the action taken by Ministry on
advice of CVC to take action against
culprits including lodging FIR in recruitment
scam in National Council for Cooperative
Training (NCCT)?
Training for agricultural and allied
activities through KVKs
*424. DR. KANWAR DEEP SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal to start
training for agricultural and allied activities
through Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs);
(b) if so, the number of such KVKs
identified for this purpose in Uttar Pradesh,
West Bengal and Punjab;
(c) if so, by when it will be done and the
criteria thereof;
(d) whether some extra assistance
would be given to KVKs for the purpose;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Issuance of Aadhaar cards in North-
Eastern States
*425. SHRI A. VIJAY AKUMAR: Will
the Minister of ELECTRONICS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of Aadhaar cards issued
in North-Eastern region during the last three
years;
(b) whether it is a fact that people are
not showing interest in getting Aadhaar
cards;
(c) if so, the action taken by Government
to cover North-Eastern States by issuing
of more Aadhaar cards;
(d) whether Government would take
steps to link Centrally-Sponsored Schemes
with Aadhaar number; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Construction of ROBs
*426. SHRI MANAS RANJAN
BHUNIA: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether many ROBs on different
roads are due to be constructed;
(b) if so, the numbers thereof; and
(c) the reasons for delay in starting the
construction of ROB at Balichak on Debra-
Sabang road under Kharagpur division of
South Eastern Railway?
Price of urea
*427. SHRI A. K. SELV ARAJ: Will the
Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has approved
continuation of the urea subsidy till 2020
at an estimated cost of  ` 1,64,935 crore;

151
(b) whether Government has also
approved implementation of  Direct
Benefit Transfer Scheme for disbursement
of fertilizer subsidy;
(c) whether the retail price of urea has
not been changed from ` 5360 per tonne or
` 268 per 50 kg bag since 2012; and
(d) whether the prices vary from State
to State and on an average, farmers get urea
at about ` 300 per bag?
Apprehensions on functioning of
EVMs

Worsening rural distress
4481. SHRI RANJIB BISWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether new data released by
Government on rural wages, crop prices
and sowing of winter crops reveals that
rural distress is worsening;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the names of  the States/areas/
regions where sowing area crops has
declined substantially;
(d) whether it is a fact that falling
profitability is the biggest problem for the
farmers which has come down drastically
for most crops; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the steps
being taken to speed up the implementation
of flagship programmes on crop insurance
and irrigation, which are lagging behind
due to poor implementation?
Administering of antibiotics to animals
†4482. SHRIMATI SAMPATIYA
UIKEY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that antibiotic
medicines are being administered to
animals to increase the production of meat;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
hazardous chemicals along with antibiotics
are entering the bodies of those persons
who eat meat;
(c) if so, the efforts being made by
Government in this regard; and
(d) the details thereof?
Implementation of PMFBY in
Chhattisgarh
4483. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Pradhan Mantri Fasal
Bima Yojana (PMFBY) along with the

details of insurer companies and system of
approval for insurance of agricultural yield;
(b) the details of  the premium collected
since the launch of  PMFBY till date, State/
Union Territory-wise and date-wise;
(c) the details of insurance amount
given away, State/Union Territory-wise and
date-wise;
(d) whether insurers have returned the
premium collected from farmers in
Chhattisgarh, if so, the details thereof and
reasons therefor; and
(e) whether Government has taken any
steps to resolve this problem, if so, the
details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor?
Benefit of MSP to farmers
4484. SHRI ANUBHA V MOHANTY:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the MSP, provided by
Government to the farmers, actually
benefits only 6 per cent of the farmers in
the entire country; and
(b) if so, whether Government would
consider enhancing the quantity of the
produces purchased by Government to the
maximum possible limit so that a larger
number of farmers benefit through it?
Unified Package Insurance Scheme in
Karnataka
4485. SHRI K.C. RAMAMURTHY:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) the aims and objectives of Unified
Package Insurance Scheme;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether it is a fact that this scheme
is approved to be implemented in
Chitradurga district of Karnataka State on
pilot basis; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and in what
manner it is helpful to farmers?
Pilot project for promotion of nutri-
farming
4486. SHRI PARTAP SINGH BAJWA:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has launched
a pilot programme for promotion of nutri-
farming and introducing new crop varieties
that are rich in micro-nutrients such as iron-
rich bajra, protein-rich maize and zinc-rich
wheat; and
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the quantum of funds earmarked for
implementation of this project?
Laying of foundation stone for dairy in
Jharkhand
†4487. SHRI HARIV ANSH: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Prime Minister had laid
down the foundation stone of a
Government dairy in Jharkhand without
allotment of land for the same;
(b) if so, the details of the place and
land area for dairy in Jharkhand where
Prime Minister had laid down the
foundation stone; and
(c) by when this dairy would be set up?

1054
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Development of cluster-based model
for agriculture
4488. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to associate all the districts
in the country to specialize in some or other
agricultural produce; and
(b) if so, whether Government would
like to give a thrust on to develop cluster-
based model in a scientific manner as an
effort to promote and encourage
Agriculture sector in the country?
